_doc: Element chart (docs/BALANCE.md, Type chart). strong = elements this one hits for strong_mult. The reverse direction takes weak_mult; every other pair is neutral. Dual defenders multiply. era = first era the element appears in; Era II elements sit only on legendary (ancient) Spirlings so far. A pair that beats each other (Lumen and Umbra) is neutral both ways and counts as neither strength nor weakness. Checked by tools/balance/type_sim.py and tests/unit/test_type_chart.gd: every element has at least 2 real strengths and 2 real weaknesses and no element strictly dominates another.
